title: Online Guitar Tuner – Free 6-String EADGBE Chromatic Tuner
description: Tune your guitar online with our free client-side guitar tuner. Uses your microphone to detect pitch and tune to standard EADGBE tuning.

content.heading: Tune Your Guitar to Standard EADGBE Online
bodyParagraphs: This online instrument tuner is pre-configured for standard 6-string guitar tuning (E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4). It listens to your guitar strings using your microphone, showing the pitch offset dynamically.
Your audio signals are processed 100% locally in your browser. No data is sent to external servers.

title: Online Drop D Guitar Tuner – Free DADGBE Tuner Template
description: Tune your guitar to Drop D tuning (DADGBE) online. Responsive pitch detector runs 100% locally inside your browser.

content.heading: Tune Your Guitar to Drop D (DADGBE) Online
bodyParagraphs: Drop D tuning lowers your lowest string by a whole step from E2 to D2, enabling heavy bass sounds and one-finger power chords. Standard guitar strings 2-6 (A2, D3, G3, B3, E4) remain unchanged.
Use our microphone pitch analyzer to drop your E string safely to a clean D pitch.

title: Online 7-String Guitar Tuner – Free BEADGBE Tuner
description: Tune your 7-string guitar online to standard BEADGBE tuning. Accurate local microphone frequency tracking.

content.heading: Tune Your 7-String Guitar to Standard (BEADGBE) Online
bodyParagraphs: 7-string guitars add a low B1 string below standard E-tuning, widely popular in metal, jazz, and progressive genres. The full setup maps to B1, E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4.
Simply select the string and pluck it. Our tuner will guide you visually until each note is aligned perfectly.

title: Online Drop A 7-String Guitar Tuner – Free AEADGBE Tuner
description: Tune your 7-string guitar to Drop A (AEADGBE) tuning online. Premium browser pitch tracking with absolute privacy.

content.heading: Tune Your 7-String Guitar to Drop A (AEADGBE) Online
bodyParagraphs: Drop A drops the low B string down to A1, aligning standard interval chord shapes across your bottom strings. The strings map to A1, E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4.
Pluck your bottom strings and adjust them using our interactive tuning visualizer.

title: Online 8-String Guitar Tuner – Free F#BEADGBE Tuner

content.heading: Standard 8-String Guitar Tuner (F#BEADGBE) Online
bodyParagraphs: 8-string guitars extend the lower range further by adding a low F#1 string below the B1 string, common in heavy progressive metal. Standard tuning is F#1, B1, E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4.
Our specialized low-pitch processing algorithm tracks low frequency cycles dynamically.

title: Online Drop E 8-String Guitar Tuner – Free EBEADGBE Tuner

content.heading: Tune Your 8-String Guitar to Drop E (EBEADGBE) Online
bodyParagraphs: Drop E tuning drops your lowest string down to E1, matching standard bass registers for massive heavy riffs. The full scale maps to E1, B1, E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4.
Calibrate your instrument's bottom strings with our high-fidelity, client-side pitch detector.

content.heading: Standard GCEA Ukulele Tuner Online

Simply grant microphone access, pluck a string, and follow the needle to tune your instrument securely in seconds.
